description: Clear the value of the input/textarea identified by ref or selector (sets it to empty). Options: force, timeoutMs. Returns: { ok, session_id, target, cleared }. Errors: REF_NOT_FOUND / SELECTOR_NO_MATCH (carries similar_refs), ELEMENT_NOT_VISIBLE (retryable), ELEMENT_DISABLED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

name: electron_clear_input
title: Clear an input
